messages:
alois: quick triage note  ran PolarisX-13B mainline through our awq-int4 and per-channel int8 flows. short prompts fine, but multi-turn summarization with long context exhibits token-drop and repeated paragraphs after ~900 tokens. fp16 baseline doesn't show this.

devika: that pattern smells like kv-cache misindexing or rotary-phase aliasing. which conversion flags used?

alois: used rwd-convert default awq for int4 and per-channel int8 for int8. reproducer below.

```
# convert
rwd-convert --src polarisx-13b/fp16.ckpt --dst polarisx-awq.int4 --method awq --block-size 128 --headwise-quant true --calib-samples 1024
rwd-convert --src polarisx-13b/fp16.ckpt --dst polarisx-int8.perch.quant --method per_channel_int8 --block-size 128 --calib-samples 2048

# infer
rwd-infer --model polarisx-awq.int4 --task summarize --prompt-file tests/long/multi_turn_article.txt --max-tokens 2048 --dump-toks --dump-attn heads=all
```

oscar: any token-id diffs between fp16 and int4 runs? tokenizer parity often bites us.

alois: ran token-id diffs on a failing thread  ids mostly matched except at sentence boundaries where we use a tokenpad sentinel. fp16 -> [101, 402, 999, 2, 78] vs int4 -> [101, 402, 999, 12807, 78]  sentinel id changed. artifact metadata shows tokenizer.tokenpad = "sentinel_v2" in model card but converter wrote "sentinel_v1".

devika: oof. that alone explains some boundary behavior. but repeating paragraphs suggests degraded attention past KV boundary. what do attn dumps show?

alois: attention energy in mid-late layers shows near-zero contributions from heads 4 and 11 after token index ~920 in int4; fp16 remains stable. head energies:
float16 last-layer mags: [0.12,0.11,0.13,0.10,0.09,0.12,0.11,0.13,0.12,0.10,0.11,0.12,0.09,0.13,0.10,0.11]
int4 last-layer mags:    [0.11,0.10,0.00,0.09,0.00,0.11,0.10,0.12,0.11,0.00,0.00,0.00,0.08,0.12,0.09,0.10]

oscar: several zeroed heads  could be qkv-layout mismatch or per-block scale underflow. check checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout and converter logs.

alois: checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout = "hnp" (per-head first), converter debug: "canonicalizing qkv to nhp"  so converter may have flipped axes incorrectly for this family. quant logs show scale tensors computed shape mismatches but didn't error.

quant-bot: queued probe-run 74231: re-convert forcing --qkv-layout hnp and another run with --per-channel-scale-clamp 1e-5. Also test forced tokenizer.tokenpad=sentinel_v2 override.

eval-bot: started run 74231 subset=long-summarize (50 examples)

[6m later]

alois: quick results (50 ex):
- int4 (orig) => repeat@1k 41/50, Rouge-L 28.2, p50 62ms
- int4 (tokenpad fixed to sentinel_v2) => repeat@1k 32/50, Rouge-L 35.1, p50 61ms
- int4 (qkv-layout=hnp) => repeat@1k 6/50, Rouge-L 52.4, p50 64ms
- int4 (qkv-layout=hnp + scale-clamp=1e-5) => repeat@1k 4/50, Rouge-L 53.0
- int8 (per-channel, qkv-layout=hnp) => repeat@1k 3/50, Rouge-L 55.8, p50 118ms
- fp16 baseline => repeat@1k 2/50, Rouge-L 57.2, p50 220ms

devika: pretty clear root causes: (1) tokenizer tokenpad metadata mismatch caused sentence-boundary id drift; (2) qkv-layout canonicalization bug caused scale computation across wrong axis which zeroed per-head scales in int4 path. the clamp helped but layout fix recovered most quality.

oscar: follow-ups: add converter guard that if checkpoint.metadata.qkv_layout exists and differs from our expected, require explicit override in non-interactive runs and log a warning. add a per-head scale histogram gate that fails if >2 heads have scale < 1e-6.

alois: also propose adding token-id parity smoke in converter CI: sample 100 multilingual prompts including tokenpad/sentinel cases and fail if token id mismatches >1%.

quant-bot: creating PR draft: converter: preserve tokenizer.tokenpad unless user changes; require explicit qkv-layout flag when checkpoint.qkv_layout present; add scale-histogram gate; add int4 rotary_scale sweep [0.85,1.0,1.15] in calibration and record best rotary_scale in artifact metadata.

ops-bot: job 74231 completed  artifacts: polarisx-awq-v2.quant (qkv_layout fixed, tokenpad fixed), calib.json uploaded.

devika: one more note: long-context repeats sometimes triggered by kv-cache index offset when tokenpad id changed, so tokenpad mismatch is amplifying the effect. make tokenpad check high-priority in onboarding checklist for long-context models.

alois: opening PR with tests + artifact metadata note recommending rotary_scale 0.9 for AWQ on PolarisX (observed best on long summarize). tagging @devika @oscar for review.

oscar: +1. let's add a tiny long-context summarize smoke (2 examples) to the onboarding suite to catch this class of regressions early.

alois: thanks all, saving calibration plots and headwise scale histograms to the model repo.
